proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.choice
proposed_widenings.justification: Daylight allows casting on either a point in space (area sphere) or an object not worn/carried (object emanation). This is a cast-time choice between two fundamentally different attachment kinds, not just different effect atoms. The surface has no Attachment.choice variant; each phase fixes one attachment kind.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the sunlight to fill a 60-foot Emanation originating from that object.

proposed_widenings.name: end_ongoing_spells spatial+type filter
proposed_widenings.justification: The auto-dispel fires automatically (no player action) and only dispels spells that (a) created darkness and (b) have overlapping areas with Daylight's area. The existing end_ongoing_spells atom has no spatial-overlap predicate and no spell-effect-type filter (darkness category). Both constraints are needed to encode this honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

proposed_widenings.name: emit_light.lightKind
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell explicitly produces sunlight, which is mechanically distinct from ordinary bright light: creatures with Sunlight Sensitivity suffer disadvantage while in it; undead and other creatures sensitive to sunlight are affected. The current emit_light atom has no lightKind field to distinguish sunlight from regular bright light.
proposed_widenings.evidence: For the duration, sunlight spreads from a point within range and fills a 60-foot-radius Sphere.

notes: The emit_light mechanic for the primary area-sphere mode encodes cleanly. JSON typechecks and tracer succeeds. Three surface widenings prevent full encode: (1) cast-time attachment kind choice (area vs object), (2) spatial-overlap + darkness-type filter on end_ongoing_spells, (3) sunlight quality on emit_light. The encoded portion is an honest partial trace of the primary cast mode only.
